title: Bind every declared acceptance to at least one Bun test

facts.note: The plan declares one or more acceptances. This alone qualifies the rule; it applies in every phase, with no phase restriction.

Signals a violation, not a precondition: produced by the atdd_traceability_closure validator joining declared acceptances against Bun test bindings. Its result is not exposed as an activation fact today.

fires: A plan declares an acceptance and no Bun test is bound to it, whatever phase the work is in.
A previously bound test is removed or its binding changed so a declared acceptance is left without any test.
doesNotFire: Every declared acceptance is bound by at least one Bun test.

given: A plan declares one or more acceptances
when: the planner declares, edits or keeps an acceptance in the plan (at any phase; the closure validator checks this whenever it runs)
then: Every declared acceptance is bound by at least one Bun test.
why: An acceptance with no bound test cannot be executed or checked, so the plan claims behaviour that nothing proves.
evidence: The atdd_traceability_closure validator reports zero declared acceptances lacking a bound Bun test.
verifier_detail: Implemented as a validator (ref: atdd_traceability_closure). Strict disposition: every unbound acceptance is a finding.
The concrete representation of an acceptance-to-test binding is whatever the atdd_traceability_closure validator recognises; this rule does not define a new binding format.

sharedNodes.text: strict: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.
